presentation.title: Umbraco local Cluster — Dimentionalizer
presentation.headline: Umbraco local Cluster.
presentation.description: The checked-in Umbraco demo: CM + two CDs, YARP, SQL-backed cache, shared filesystem media, and Aspire tools. Local development; the Astro frontend is independent of Umbraco.

objects.name: Editor browser
objects.description: Uses the CM backoffice through cm.dev.localhost. This is a client role, not an AppHost resource.

objects.name: Visitor browser
objects.description: Uses the public CD host or the independent Astro frontend. These are separate sites in the demo.

objects.name: YARP reverse proxy
objects.description: Routes the CM hostname to CM over HTTPS and the CD hostname to CD1/CD2 over HTTP. Present in the demo Cluster branch; not started in Single mode.

objects.name: CM · SchedulingPublisher
objects.description: One Umbraco web process handles backoffice authoring and scheduled publishing. It runs startup and scheduled health checks and sends failed-check notifications to Mailpit.

objects.name: CD1 · Subscriber
objects.description: First delivery process serves the website with backoffice paths disabled. AppHost waits for CM before starting this resource.

objects.name: CD2 · Subscriber
objects.description: Second delivery process serves the same shared content. AppHost waits for CD1 before starting this resource.

objects.name: SQL Server · content database
objects.description: One persistent SQL Server 2022 database serves all Umbraco processes and also hosts dbo.DistributedCache. This snapshot does not use Redis.

objects.name: SQL distributed cache · logical table
objects.description: Logical cache backed by dbo.DistributedCache in the same content database, configured with AddDistributedSqlServerCache. This is not a separate server or container.

objects.name: Shared filesystem media
objects.description: CM, CD1, and CD2 use a common local media root. The checked-in demo selects filesystem media, not Blob/Azurite.

objects.name: Shared local keys
objects.description: Shared filesystem data-protection keys and an imaging HMAC key under the web project local directory. No key values are included in this preset.

objects.name: Aspire AppHost
objects.description: Orchestrates the local resource graph. This snapshot describes the demo Cluster branch; Single is an alternative mode, not an additional simultaneous node. Source: https://github.com/hallojoe/umbraco-topology/tree/3ce66024ac9e5dc603d42185001656c092a5b425/demo/Example.UmbracoSite

objects.name: Aspire dashboard
objects.description: Displays resource status, traces, and metrics. The web processes and YARP use Aspire Service Defaults.

objects.name: Mailpit
objects.description: Captures local SMTP mail. AppHost supplies its endpoint to each web process; failed health-check mail is generated by CM in Cluster mode.

objects.name: DbGate
objects.description: Local SQL database inspection tool attached by WithDbGate when AppHost runs in development.

objects.name: Umbraco Developer MCP
objects.description: Local MCP tooling connects to the CM management endpoint using generated client configuration. Credentials are intentionally omitted.

objects.name: Astro frontend
objects.description: Independent Astro/Starlight site launched by AddViteApp. Its pages come from local frontend/src/content/docs files; it does not call the Umbraco delivery API or use YARP.

connections.label: Management API via public CM URL
